'''Emba''' served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], he was [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Tempest (Victory-class)|''Tempest'']].
